feed.title: NPR Topics: Science
feed.subtitle: The latest health and science news. Updates on medicine, healthy living, nutrition, drugs, diet, and advances in science and technology. Subscribe to the Health & Science podcast.

entry.title: What's the secret ingredient in these cookies? Plastic
entry.summary: New research at the American Chemical Society meeting showcased a potentially edible cookie made out of — plastic!

entry.title: NPR spent 2 years tracking deaths from heat. We found a staggering hidden toll
entry.summary: An NPR investigation found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat much more often than official counts show. We explore the reasons why — and how lives can be saved.

entry.title: Why too many women are prescribed antibiotics for UTIs they don't have
entry.summary: A recent study found that many women treated for recurrent UTIs didn't have UTIs at all. Instead, their symptoms were caused by hormonally driven inflammation and pelvic floor dysfunction.

entry.title: Exclusive: Meet the inaugural winner of Fat Marmot Week
entry.summary: Dawn was crowned fattest marmot by popular vote.

entry.title: 'A glorious dawn launch': NASA's newest space telescope has left the Earth
entry.summary: The tour-bus-sized telescope aims to unravel cosmic mysteries and identify more than 100,000 planets beyond our solar system.

entry.title: The U.S. relied on these science advisers. Then the Trump administration cut them
entry.summary: The federal government recruits top experts to volunteer to advise on pressing research issues of the day. Since President Trump took office, hundreds of these experts have been dismissed.

entry.title: Scientists collaborated with narwhals to study warming waters in the Arctic
entry.summary: Scientists collaborated with narwhals for a new study to understand human-caused climate change in the Arctic and rising sea levels around the world.

entry.title: New Jersey is a fossil hotspot, with answers about the day the dinosaurs died
entry.summary: Paleontologist Ken Lacovara never expected to find critical fossil data in a New Jersey suburb—let alone info about the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs. His dig site is now a fossil park and museum.

entry.title: NASA is about to launch a space telescope that could change how we see the universe
entry.summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches Aug. 30 on a mission to explore some of the most pressing mysteries of the cosmos.

entry.title: A melting glacier contributed to the deadly Nepal floods. We can expect more like this
entry.summary: As the climate continues to warm, scientists warn that the frequency of disasters like the floods in Nepal will increase.
